scope: Preserve the explicitly typed null of the R2013+ LAYER trailing hard-pointer field during DWG encoding; no object graph or version support claim is added.
authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 2.13 and 20.4.54 describe the hard-pointer role and handle encodings.

The existing source-span receipt docs/research/p6-ac1018plus-layer-body-handle-role-spans-2026-11-09.json records the physical AC1027 Cover LAYER 0 trailing raw code 5, target 0, and a preceding nonzero linetype hard pointer.
implementation: When the trailing AC1027+ handle has ref=0, ref64=0 and an explicit hard-pointer code, retain code 5 instead of normalizing it to the untyped null code 0. Nonzero references and default untyped nulls keep their prior behavior; the existing synthetic AC1027 handling is unchanged.
No public class layout or interface virtual changed. This preserves the encoded null role; it does not establish semantics of the unknown target, graph closure or whole-file support.
validation: Before the fix, the focused test failed both the typed-null decode and subsequent re-encode checks. After the fix, generated AC1027/AC1032 controls preserve the 0x50 trailing handle byte and preceding linetype; an invalid-color attempt leaves caller and all three output buffers unchanged and the corrected same-buffer retry succeeds. Existing nonzero and canonical null vectors also pass.

The existing local Cover.dwg source (SHA-256 3a6c23151ebec25320722f0ecaaf20a10073c60079d3616181395f1c73deee42) was read and its layer 0x10 re-encoded. The source trailing handle was code 5/target 0 and the output ended with 0x50. Reproduce with: /usr/bin/g++ -std=gnu++17 -O0 -I src -I tests tools/research/probe_ac1027_layer_typed_null.cpp build-gcc/libdxfrw.a -o <scratch-probe>; <scratch-probe> <Cover.dwg>.

The fast LAYER handle-role selector, AC1024 layer binding, and default plotstyle/material transaction selectors pass; the legacy LC3 consumer compatibility target builds. The source file was not committed and no new DWG/DXF fixtures were added.
